## data

```{r message = FALSE}
set.seed(454)
# load libraries
library(tidyverse) #ofc
library(rstan)
library(readr)
library(bayesplot)
curling <- read_csv("curling.csv") ## make sure to set working directory to source file location
```


```{r output=FALSE}
## Complete Pooling approach

# Make data object
run_data <- list(N = nrow(curling),
                 x = as.integer(curling$PowerPlay),
                 y = curling$USWin,
                 z = curling$Points, 
                 m0 = 0,
                 m1 = 0,
                 m2 = 0,
                 s0 = 2,
                 s1 = 2,
                 s2 = 2)

# Fit model in Stan
fit <- stan(file = "completepooling.stan", ## make sure to set working directory to source file location
            data = run_data, 
            chains = 4, 
            warmup = 1000,
            iter = 2000)
```

```{r output=FALSE}
## Complete Pooling approach

# making unique indices for each match 
curling <- curling %>%
  mutate(k=as.integer(as.factor(CompetitionName)), # competition indices
         uniqueMatchID = str_c(MatchID, k),
         j = as.integer(as.factor(uniqueMatchID)) # match indices (all matches across competitions have a unique)
         )
  

# Make data object
run_data_partial <- list(N = nrow(curling),
                 x = as.integer(curling$PowerPlay),
                 y = curling$USWin,
                 z = curling$Points,
                 n_competitions = length(unique(curling$CompetitionName)),
                 n_matches = length(unique(curling$uniqueMatchID)),
                 k = curling$k, # competition indices
                 j = curling$j, # match indices
                 w0 = 0, w1 = 0, w2 = 0,
                 sigma0 = 1, sigma1 = 1, sigma2 = 1, 
                 # I'm not sure how to pick reasonable values for the Gamma models 
                 c0 = 1, c1 = 1, c2=1,
                 d0=1, d1=1, d2=1,
                 f0 = 1, f1=1, f2=1, 
                 g0=1, g1=1, g2=1, 
                 q0=1, q1=1, q2=1, 
                 r0=1, r1=1, r2=1)

# Fit model in Stan
fit_partial <- stan(file = "partialpooling.stan", ## make sure to set working directory to source file location
            data = run_data_partial, 
            chains = 4, 
            warmup = 1000,
            iter = 2000)
```
